WWF Raw – 2001 Results

Taped 12/29/00; Austin, TX; Frank Erwin Center
1/1/01:
The Undertaker pinned Rikishi with a DDT; due to prematch stipulations, the Undertaker advanced to a #1 contender’s match on Smackdown!
The Acolytes (w/ Jackie) & Billy Gunn defeated the Goodfather, Val Venis, & Bull Buchanon (w/ Steven Richards & WWF Women’s Champion Ivory) when Gunn pinned Venis with the Cobra Clutch slam
WWF Hardcore Champion Raven pinned Crash Holly backstage after spraying him with a fire extinguisher as Crash attempted to pin Tazz, then hitting him over the head with a 2×4; the bout was originally a title defense against Tazz but Crash, Molly, and Hardcore Holly and Steve Blackman interfered once the match went backstage
Chris Jericho & the Dudley Boyz defeated WWF World Champion Kurt Angle, WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian in a tables match when Edge was sent through the table with the 3D
WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit pinned Test (w/ Trish Stratus) when Trish pushed the challenger off the top after Test fought off an interfering Albert; after the bout, Test and Albert brawled at ringside until referees stepped in
Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Lita) defeated Taka Michinoku & Sho Funaki when Matt pinned Funaki after Jeff hit the Swanton
Kane pinned the Rock with the chokeslam after Kurt Angle interfered and hit the Rock with the world title belt on the floor before rolling the Rock back into the ring; due to prematch stipulations, Kane advanced to a #1 contender’s match on Smackdown!
WWF European Champion William Regal pinned Steve Austin with a roll up in a non-title match when guest referee Stephanie McMahon made a fast count; due to prematch stipulations, Regal advanced to a #1 contender’s match on Smackdown!

1/8/01; San Jose, CA; HP Pavilion
1/8/01:
Chris Jericho, Matt & Jeff Hardy (w/ Lita) defeated WWF IC Champion Chris Benoit, Perry Saturn (w/ Terri), & Dean Malenko when Jericho countered an attempt by Benoit at the Crippler Crossface into a roll up
Billy Gunn pinned Val Venis with the cobra clutch slam in a lumberjack match; the bout was originally scheduled as a steel cage match but was changed without explanation
The Rock, Jack Doan, & Teddy Long defeated Kane & Rikishi via disqualification in a handicap match when Kane grabbed a steel chair; after the bout, the Undertaker came out for the save
WWF Hardcore Champion Raven defeated Steve Blackman after Hardcore Holly interfered; after the bout, all three men continued brawling until Raven escaped in a waiting car
Albert & Trish Stratus defeated Test in a handicap match when Albert scored the pin with the Baldo Bomb after William Regal interfered
Steve Austin fought WWF World Champion Kurt Angle to a no contest at around 12:20 when Triple H came ringside, pulled referee Earl Hebner out of the ring as Austin had Angle covered with the Stunner, led Hebner around the ring by his hair, and ultimately knocked him out with a punch; after the bout, Austin threw Angle to the floor and invited Triple H into the ring; after battling in the ring and at ringside, Triple H busted Austin open with a series of blows with a steel pipe, finally laying Austin across the announce table and posing on top of Austin’s motionless body as the show came to a close (Action!)

1/15/01; Milwaukee, WI; Bradley Center
1/15/01:
Lita, Matt & Jeff Hardy defeated Steven Richards, Val Venis, & WWF Women’s Champion Ivory when Lita pinned Ivory with the Twist of Fate after Chyna came ringside and pushed Ivory back inside the ring; after the bout, Chyna accepted Ivory’s challenge for a match at the Royal Rumble
WWF Hardcore Champion Raven pinned Test after William Regal interfered backstage; during the bout, both Hardcore Holly and Steve Blackman interfered until the two began brawling with each other
The Undertaker & Rikishi defeated the Rock & Kane when the Undertaker pinned Rock with the powerbomb after Kane turned on his partner and hit a chokeslam before walking out of the match
Hardcore Holly fought Steve Blackman to a no contest when the referee left ringside after being hit
Trish Stratus fought Jackie to a no contest in a spanking match when Kurt Angle came ringside and pulled Trish out of the ring (Divas in Hedonism)
Tazz, Taka Michinoku, & Sho Funaki defeated K-Kwick & Too Cool when K-Kwick submitted to the Tazzmission
Steve Austin & the Acolytes defeated WWF World Champion Kurt Angle & WWF Tag Team Champions Edge & Christian when Austin pinned Angle with the Stunner; after the bout, Triple H attempted to provoke Austin into attacking him and thus losing his spot in the Royal Rumble match; eventually, Kurt Angle hit the Olympic Slam on Triple H and Austin, in turn, hit the Stunner on Angle
